note: One replay case per stay on the ward board, built from the same deidentified public eICU CRD Demo 2.0.1 observations the board reads. Every value is a recorded measurement; nothing is interpolated, carried forward or generated.
variable_scope: Laboratory results, urine output, mean arterial pressure and temperature. Heart rate, oxygen saturation and respiratory rate are recorded every few minutes in this dataset and are omitted so a stay stays replayable; they are absent from these cases, not missing from the source.
